jobs.prompt: Bump the version from 1.166.0 to 1.167.0. In package.json and package-lock.json (both places in the lock: the top version and packages[""].version) change 1.166.0 to 1.167.0. In README.md change every 1.166.0 pin (kickoff text, tag name) to 1.167.0. In these tests replace the 1.166.0 pin with 1.167.0 where it is the current-version pin (assertions, test titles, the pin map in the AH release test): tests/t101-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs, tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs. In CHANGELOG.md add a NEW top entry ## 1.167.0 above the 1.166.0 entry (keep it unchanged) with the lead-in line: Self-correcting splits, local disk cleanup, structured review verdicts and restart-any-board. And these bullets with a bold lead word like the 1.166.0 entry: Splitter: a split that fails validation is re-split with the exact errors fed back up to 3 rounds (--max-repairs); change orders re-split automatically; unresolved ones become parked blockers naming the tickets and file; guards for tests with code, no references to files another ticket creates, and protected files. | Disk: a run's worktrees are removed after integrate or abandon, failed and cancelled run workspaces are kept 7 days (SWARM_KEEP_FAILED_DAYS) and never removed while an open ticket references them, and swarm gc (dry run by default, --apply, --all-projects, --json --usage) cleans old runs and stale scratch. | Review: review jobs use a strict response schema and the verdict is recorded from the structured result, with prose kept as notes. | Update: swarm update restarts any running board or remote server found by process, with or without a record. | Resume: a ticket in review without a review run now writes its acceptance-review manifest first, a missing manifest gives a clear error, and a start failure repeated twice parks the ticket. | Board: federated snapshot and owner Approve/Deny routes on the watch server (tailnet only; merge, deploy and cap actions refused). | Hooks: every swarm hook points at current; swarm change previews are allowed; acceptance reviews skip tickets in other worktrees with a note. Then run tests/t101-release.test.mjs tests/field-lesson-t80-cli.test.mjs tests/field-lessons-batch-x.test.mjs tests/field-lessons-batch-ab-release.test.mjs tests/field-lessons-batch-ag-release.test.mjs tests/field-lessons-batch-ah-release.test.mjs and make them pass. Change nothing else.
jobs.ignoreTestsReason: tests that reference these files in passing are covered by the full suite run before merge
